profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI, Data & Analytics | Turning Data into Information, Information into Insights, and Insights into Action | MS Analytics
profile.summary:
I have a strong interest in pursuing an analytics career in a creative, innovative, stimulating and challenging environment. I constantly am thinking of ways to advance myself personally and in business practices. I have the drive, motivation, and passion to excel at anything I put my mind to. 

For my background, I have experience with Python, SAS, R, SQL, maintaining and creating company websites (HTML, CSS, ASP.Net, Adobe DreamWeaver, and Adobe Muse, Microsoft Visual Studio, JavaScript, PHP), predictive modeling, statistical analysis, data mining, as well as testing to ensure quality in analytical products. 

My following certifications include: Advanced Programmer SAS 9 Certification, Statistical Business Analyst SAS 9 Certification, SAS Certified Predictive Modeler Using SAS Enterprise Miner 13, HubSpot Inbound Marketing Certification and Google Analytics IQ Certification.

Patents: US10303516 - Allocating computing resources for providing various datasets to client devices

When I am not working, I enjoy going to the gym/running, reading, volunteering, skiing, paddle boarding/kayaking, gardening, and baking with sourdough.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed an AI framework supporting multiple AI models and projects, including analysis of survey data, community comments, and other sources for sentiment, CSAT/CES drivers, aspect-level tagging, insights, and user frustration detection.
- Pioneered an AI-native, Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflow using OpenSpec while re-architecting and migrating a data pipeline from GCP to Snowflake; cut development time 50%, increased test coverage from 60% to 98%, consolidated 1/3 of business rules into a centralized engine, reduced defect risk, and cut GCP costs $40–50K annually—all without additional headcount.
- Leveraged Snowflake Cortex Analyst to enhance an existing agentic AI bot with natural-language data capabilities, enabling stakeholder self-service and reducing dependency on ad-hoc data requests.
- Leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, optimize code, and improve documentation.
- Developed and managed a data platform to cleanse, rank, and deliver contacts across Cisco for customer success, renewals, digital campaigns, NPS surveys, and more.
- Implemented data science models to rank contacts by engagement, improving targeting and campaign effectiveness.
- Automated Data Subject Request workflows, reducing compliance response times from 10–15 days to 1 day.
- Developed data pipelines, dashboards, and automated reporting serving 200+ Cisco stakeholders, distributors, and partners.
- Identified data gaps and implemented architecture enhancements that improved data quality and platform adoption.
- Served as SME on partner, customer success, and contact data, advising leadership and simplifying complex data challenges.
- Led partner analytics and reporting for Lifecycle Advantage, Cisco’s partner platform.
- Spearheaded development, data strategy, and requirements for Lifecycle Advantage, resulting in 152% usage growth and ~6,231% ROI growth.
- Finalist for 2 “Best of We” awards under Cisco’s ELT.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed dashboards, data pipelines, and automated reporting using Python, SQL (connection to snowflake), Tableau, and Tableau TCRM that provided visibility to the company as well as to Cisco distributors and partners on KPI and metrics which were previously unavailable and ultimately led to over 200 users
•	Presented data analyses and gaps/holes in the data architecture and solutioned ideas to enhance the current architecture of sales and customer success processes as well as the Lifecycle Advantage and PX Cloud platform for partners
•	Communicated with developers, product managers, stakeholders, and industry experts to define data requirements and architecture 
•	Served as the subject matter expert on partner and customer success data 
•	Led the analytics and reporting efforts to understand partner usage of our platform, Lifecycle Advantage

positions.title: Manager & Lead of BI & Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics
positions.description: Led & managed a team of 2 data analysts in supply chain analytics

positions.title: Senior Analyst BI & Analytics
positions.description:
• Performed statistical analyses using data from various sources (Oracle, Hadoop, Teradata, DB2)
    - Experimental Design and measurement of numerous pilots
    - Optimized the allocation of product from DC's based on demand for seasonal items and for severe weather items during a storm
    - Clustered stores together based on characteristics of pick up in store customer behavior to propose 
multiple operating models 
    - Detection of spikes/anomalies in demand to recommend how an item should flow
    - Determined inventory assignment based on how fast product moved through the supply chain and stores to enhance inventory practices (optimization) 
    -  Performed a market basket analysis to understand what customers bought together when a severe weather storm hits so we can better allocate those products to an emergency distribution center 

• Presented to executive leadership and VP's analyses and provided recommendations based on results of the analyses

• Created dashboards and automated reporting using Alteryx, Python, Microstrategy, and/or SQL that provided visibility to the company on KPI and metrics that were previously not available

Skills: Python, SQL, Alteryx, Data Mining, Statistical Analysis

patents.title: Allocating computing resources for providing various datasets to client devices
patents.description: One exemplary system can determine datasets to be transmitted to client devices for eliciting performance of a computing-task. The datasets include a first dataset and a second dataset. The system can then generate sets of data-curves for each of the datasets based on test data. The system can also generate a new client-device (NCD) projection based on the test data. The system can generate a new client-device task-completion (NCDTC) projection using (i) the NCD projection, and (ii) a particular set of data-curves for the first dataset. The system can determine a first value based at least in part on the NCDTC projection. The system can also determine a second value via series of steps. The system can determine an impact value by subtracting the second value from the first value. The system may allocate computing resources based on the first value, the second value, or the impact value.
